method: Items are published only when an official primary source or at least two independent publishers support them.

items.headline: Sheinbaum meets US ambassador and business leaders on investment, USMCA and security
items.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum received US Ambassador Ronald Johnson and representatives of US and Mexican business groups at the National Palace on 8 October. Topics were investment, the USMCA (T-MEC) review, tariffs and border security. Business council head José Medina Mora said Johnson recognised Mexico's security progress; no tariff changes were announced.
items.note: No official readout had been published at the time of reporting; statements by participants are attributed. The Rio Times reports that the meeting lasted about two and a half hours, citing El Universal.
